checks.name: live frame textures stay within cache slots plus active actor references

composite_pixel_evidence.comparison: Actual Sprite2D.texture.get_image() against external Aseprite proof for all 192x192 pixels. Pixels outside the runtime crop are transparent; compare alpha everywhere and RGB wherever either image has nonzero alpha.

limits: Rendered sample contains 32 actors, not a large RTS capacity claim.
Frame intervals include OS scheduling and vertical synchronization. The engine process-time monitor updates coarsely and is not a per-actor CPU profiler.
Screenshots and structural checks do not replace user approval of new rear views, clothing, and animation.
